items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Mr. Seedman, Tony Jackson was a master there...

ctx.x: Who were some outstanding piano players around Chicago?

Well, Mr. Seedman, Tony Jackson was a master there, same as he was here when they had to ride his in Chicago. For one. There was Dave Payton was another crackerjack piano player. And another, well he played at the Owl, what is his name again? He played at the Owl, that's a long second, he'll get his name in a few minutes. He was a crackerjack piano player.
Well let me ask you about somebody. Did you ever know Charlie Cook? Doc Cook?
